QuestInfo.name: [Stone Colossus] Snipe Hunt
QuestInfo.1: Chino wants you to hunt #r100 Hornets#k and #Poison Hornets#k in the #bSwarm Habitat#k.
QuestInfo.2: You took out 100 Hornets and Poison Hornets for Chino.

0.msg: The name's Chino, and this is my trusty rifle, Martino. I came out here to scout the area before the rest of the expedition arrived. Me and Martino have been making the place safe... Kupo must have told you about me, right?

1.msg: #b(He said you're extremely capable and exterminate hornets with extreme prejudice...)#k

2.msg: Hmph! I'm gonna blast those ugly goggles right off of his head next time I catch him in Martino's crosshairs!

3.msg: Anyway... There's an #belevator me and the team have been using to get to the Stone Colossus#k nearby. It should make for a pretty easy trip if you want to get a closer look.

4.msg: If there were less stinging bugs flying around, I could get you up there. Between you, me, and Martino, I bet we could cut down the population enough to make it safe.

5.msg: Could you take down 100 more #rHornets and Poison Hornets#k?

yes.0: I'll provide fire support from here!\r\n#b#e(Hunt down #r100 more Hornets and Poison Hornets#b.)#k

no.0: I can't fault you for chickening out.

1.0: Did you take care of them?

yes.0: It'll be nice to go outside without having to bring my tennis racket.

mob.0: Exterminate 100 Hornets and Poison Hornets.\r\n#b#e(Hunt down #r100 more Hornets and Poison Hornets#b.)#k
